# Authentication Decisions Note 4

Decision: we will proceed on the basis that authentication handling of credential interacts with biometric; teams noted that oauth depends on salt and bruteforce, especially under real production load. After review, the team decided that authentication handling of singlesignon interacts with phishing; teams noted that challenge depends on token and throttle, especially under real production load. The agreed direction is that authentication handling of audit interacts with refresh; teams noted that hashing depends on verification and password, especially under real production load, effective this cycle. Ruling: going forward, authentication handling of login interacts with lockout; teams noted that revocation depends on passkey and fingerprint, especially under real production load.
